BEL Partners with Esri India for GeoAI, GIS & Strategic Location Intelligence

2026-08-03 PSU India BEL, Esri India, GeoAI, GIS, defense electronics, Indian Armed Forces, Location Intelligence, Indo ArcGIS, strategic partnership, MoU
Read the source article

Quick summary

Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) has signed an MoU with Esri India to deploy GeoAI, GIS, and Location Intelligence capabilities for the Indian Armed Forces, combining BEL's defense electronics with Esri's Indo ArcGIS platform for operational surge readiness.

Key takeaways

  • Navratna defense PSU BEL and Esri India signed a strategic MoU to deploy advanced Location Intelligence, GeoAI, and GIS capabilities for the Indian Armed Forces
  • The partnership combines BEL's manufacturing and systems integration ecosystem with Esri India's spatial mapping platforms and Indo ArcGIS technology
  • Key objectives include operational surge readiness for rapid GIS deployment during high-demand scenarios, technology integration, and in-house capacity building
  • Esri India will deliver technical training to BEL personnel on its proprietary Indo ArcGIS platform to build internal expertise
  • BEL manufactures over 600 multi-domain systems including Satcom, quantum technology, electro-optics, unmanned platforms, and mission-critical networks
